<translated_code>
import bisect

# Global variables
R = 0
C = 0
n = 0
p = ""
Comb = [[0]*62 for _ in range(62)]
A = [[0]*32 for _ in range(32)]
B = [[0]*32 for _ in range(32)]
CC = [[0]*32 for _ in range(32)]
TT = 0
MM = 0
Res = 0
# P and Q: list of size n+1, each element is a list of two lists (for ck=0 and 1)
P = [[[] for _ in range(2)] for _ in range(32)]
Q = [[[] for _ in range(2)] for _ in range(32)]

def Put(x, y, g, c1, c2, ck):
    if x + y == R + n:
        P[x][ck].append((g, c1))
        if c2:
            Q[x][ck].append((g, c2))
        return
    # move down (x+1, y)
    Put(x+1, y, g + (A[x+1][y] if not ck else 0), c1, (0 if p[x+y] == 'B' else c2), ck)
    # move right (x, y+1)
    Put(x, y+1, g + (B[x][y+1] if ck else 0), c1, (0 if p[x+y] == 'A' else c2), ck)

def Calc1(x, y, g, ck):
    global MM
    if x + y == R + n:
        if not P[x][ck]:
            return
        t = bisect.bisect_left(P[x][ck], ((TT+1)//2 - g, 0))
        if t < len(P[x][ck]) and P[x][ck][t][1] > 0:
            tp = (P[x][ck][t][0] + g) * 2 - TT
            if tp < 0:
                tp = -tp
            if MM > tp:
                MM = tp
        if t > 0 and P[x][ck][t-1][1] > 0:
            tp = (P[x][ck][t-1][0] + g) * 2 - TT
            if tp < 0:
                tp = -tp
            if MM > tp:
                MM = tp
        return
    # move up (x-1, y)
    Calc1(x-1, y, g + (A[x][y] if not ck else 0), ck)
    # move left (x, y-1)
    Calc1(x, y-1, g + (B[x][y] if ck else 0), ck)

def Calc2(x, y, g, ck):
    global MM, Res
    if x + y == R + n:
        t = bisect.bisect_left(Q[x][ck], ((TT+1)//2 - g, 0))
        if t < len(Q[x][ck]) and Q[x][ck][t][1] > 0:
            tp = (Q[x][ck][t][0] + g) * 2 - TT
            if tp < 0:
                tp = -tp
            if MM == tp:
                Res += Q[x][ck][t][1]
        if t > 0 and Q[x][ck][t-1][1] > 0:
            tp = (Q[x][ck][t-1][0] + g) * 2 - TT
            if tp < 0:
                tp = -tp
            if MM == tp:
                Res += Q[x][ck][t-1][1]
        return
    if p[x+y-1] != 'B':
        Calc2(x-1, y, g + (A[x][y] if not ck else 0), ck)
    if p[x+y-1] != 'A':
        Calc2(x, y-1, g + (B[x][y] if ck else 0), ck)

def Make(arr):
    if not arr:
        return
    arr.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0])
    compressed = []
    s = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(arr):
        s += arr[i][1]
        if i == len(arr)-1 or arr[i][0] != arr[i+1][0]:
            compressed.append((arr[i][0], s))
            s = 0
        i += 1
    arr[:] = compressed

def main():
    global R, C, n, p, TT, MM, Res, Comb, A, B, CC, P, Q
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    R = int(data[0])
    C = int(data[1])
    p = data[2]
    # Initialize arrays
    n = R + C
    # Comb
    for i in range(61):
        Comb[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i+1):
            Comb[i][j] = Comb[i-1][j-1] + Comb[i-1][j]
    TT = Comb[2*n][2*R]
    # A and B
    for i in range(n+1):
        for j in range(n+1):
            if i:
                A[i][j] = Comb[i-1][R-1] * (Comb[2*n-i][R] - Comb[j][R])
            if j:
                B[i][j] = Comb[j-1][R-1] * (Comb[2*n-j][R] - Comb[i][R])
    # CC
    CC[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(n+1):
        for j in range(n+1):
            if i != n and p[i+j] != 'B':
                CC[i+1][j] += CC[i][j]
            if j != n and p[i+j] != 'A':
                CC[i][j+1] += CC[i][j]
    # Put for starting points
    for i in range(R, n+1):
        if p[i+R-1] != 'B':
            Put(R, i, A[R][i], Comb[i+R-1][R-1], CC[R-1][i], 0)
        if p[i+R-1] != 'A':
            Put(i, R, B[i][R], Comb[i+R-1][R-1], CC[i][R-1], 1)
    # Make for each P/Q list
    for i in range(R, n+1):
        for j in range(2):
            Make(P[i][j])
            Make(Q[i][j])
    MM = TT + 1
    Calc1(n, n, 0, 0)
    Calc1(n, n, 0, 1)
    Calc2(n, n, 0, 0)
    Calc2(n, n, 0, 1)
    print(Res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
